Name: Baby Sam plays guitar
Author: PecuniamArt
Description:
A baby to match Sam's looks and hobby!
Instead of playing with blocks there's a little guitar. This baby has blonde hair and a new outfit as well.

Originally Sam had a green eyed sprite and blue eyed portrait so there are options for both eyes colors in this download

If you have suggestions for new versions of characters or animals, please feel free to leave a comment in the Posts section
